It has a light highlight in rows 2-4 and ends in a darker 1-row edge line at row 7 (L=71). A dark outline row 8 follows, acting as eave shadow. Below it is a red board front face of about 22 rows (9-30) carrying cream characters, which are a vertical face with no top. The cap is rounded only at its upper edge, so it could be read as a hat, but the edge line and shadow below it count as a top band. A top band plus a tall front face reads as three_quarter, though weakly.
